[Omnikinesis](/Feats.aspx?ID=4205) <actions string="Single Action" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Kineticist" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=504" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

You can realign your kinetic gate with a thought. Replace one of your [impulse](/Traits.aspx?ID=502) feats using the same process as reflow elements. You can replace only one, even if you have double reflow.
